note: Test vectors for openwaymark.org/owm/core. Part of the specification: a conforming implementation reproduces them byte for byte. Generate with: go test ./core/ -update

entries.name: assertion-minimal
entries.note: All optional fields are absent. The map has exactly six pairs.

entries.name: assertion-with-parents
entries.note: Merge of two parents, one of them with a log hint.

entries.name: revocation
entries.note: Revocation without a payload: cmt is absent, tgt is set.

entries.name: erasure
entries.note: Erasure attestation: same shape as the revocation, different statement. The payload of the target entry has been erased together with its salt, its leaf stays in the tree.

entries.name: key-rotation
entries.note: The payload carries the successor key and is not erased.

entries.name: attestation
entries.note: Entity trust-level attestation (OWM-6 §3). Subject is a foreign key, not the issuer's own — the issuer is vouching for someone else.

entries.name: sensor-reading-mldsa44
entries.note: Device key with ML-DSA-44: 2420 instead of 3309 signature bytes.
